The Truth And Logic Behind AWALT

Hello everyone, new from reddit but decided to start add a post here as well as TRP on reddit. I wanted to revisit the notion of AWALT, or all women are like that. For a lot of new readers, this is one of the hardest concepts to grasp, and due to it's very black and white nature, it is also hard to believe. I am here to explain it in an easier way. Instead of thinking of it as All Women are like that, it is better to think of it as AAWALT or Almost All Women Are Like That. Why? There will always be outliers, even with women. Their personalities, upbringing, and experiences may differentiate them from the vast majority of their female peers. But, this should not at all change the way one looks at women as a whole.

Assumption: The true man must ALWAYS assume that ANY and ALL women are like that until proven time and time again otherwise. Even then, the man must be sensitive to any behaviors or sayings that might reveal AWALT behavior. Why? Because the vast majority of time, the women a man sees will be part of the new post feminist culture, combined with thousands of years of cultural evolution of the female gender to pick up social cues or respond accordingly. Such impulses and thoughts such as hypergamy, hamstering and locking down a provider are all ways in which women have psychologically evolved and survived. For the huge majority of women, these thoughts and impulses are subconsciously ingrained in their minds, even though she may reject these ideas superficially.

Why should we assume? Safety: Why should a shooter at a gun range ALWAYS assume a gun is loaded until after the chamber has been cleared and the magazine emptied and detached? Because even though experienced shooters know the number of rounds in a full clip, or know whether or not a chamber is loaded, there is always the rogue possibility that something was miscalculated or overlooked. Even a single mistake in shooting sports can prove fatal. Therefore it is logical to always assume that the gun is loaded. Is every gun special? Yes. Is every experience and time at the range different? Yes. Does this mean that sometimes we can afford to be careless with our guns? NO! Absolutely not.

It is within this context of safety and logic that we uphold the position of AWALT. Is every girl ‘special?’ sure, to an extent. Is every day or context in a situation different? Yes. Does this mean that my plate, LTR, of wife is actually the perfect woman that is different from all the other CC Riders or hypergamy lusters in training or those who desire mostly high SMV, attention, or validation? NO! Absolutely not.

CounterPoint: “But she’s actually great man, you don’t even know!” You think of the cleaned dishes, the non-existent cheating or clingy ex boyfriends, the low partner count and the happy lack of her nudes online. “You don’t know her like I do! She’s different from all of her friends, my past girlfriends, my female coworkers, and all the other women I’ve met and talked to! It’s true, she doesn’t fall under AWALT at all.”

Though you may feel otherwise, the girl you are seeing is ESPECIALLY like the rest of the women. AWALT doesn’t somehow exclude women you grow fond of. It hurts, doesn’t it? Give yourself a moment and absorb these thoughts. Okay. Ready? The ‘perfect’ woman that you have been seeing may well have not fit the descriptions that has been indicative of some actions, but those impulses may well be in there. EVEN if you could scan the recesses of her mind and mind the perfect personality, there is still cause for concern. As we all should well know, the human mind is constantly changing, forming new opinions and ideas and casting aside old opinions in the face of an ever aggregating number of experiences. So even if she may not be a part of the AWALT by some highly improbable chance, future experiences or conversations or further exposure to the new feminist society may change her beliefs and behaviors to mold that of the AWALT that has been so fully taught here.

Exercising Logic over Emotion: Many men (and women) may grow attached to their counterparts, perhaps even to the point of codependency. Though the social acceptance of the CC for many women has created an environment where women find it significantly harder to emotionally bond with men, there is still a strong sentiment of emotional need of fulfillment through a relationship with a significant other. The dangers of such a situation are created ONLY when the otherwise wise man no longer assumes that his SO is like the HUNDREDS of other women he’s dealt with in his life. Why? Because he has developed a strong enough emotional connection and allowed his mind to mute and silence negative or AWALT characteristics of his SO while amplifying and focusing on the positive and ’different’ aspects that she may have. Men need to rule and reason with logic over emotion. When emotion begins to rule over logic, all hell can break loose and perhaps even the relationship may be lost.

Example: Guy A is regularly slapped and yelled at by his girlfriend B, but doesn’t want to break off the relationship. Guy C talks to A about why A stays with B, and A responds that the abuse actually isn’t a big deal at all, that he deserved it at each instance, and that it is A who is flawed. B was only looking out for him and therefore B is only showing her kindness and caring. Guy C is confused and in disbelief that A would think this way and says so to guy A, but A truly believes every word he has said and guy C’s logic is quickly forgotten.

Analysis: Of course, this scenario is relatable because it is a severe but common example of a person overlooking the flaws and flags of a relationship simply because they are EMOTIONALLY attached and therefore are thinking EMOTIONALLY instead of logically. To a lesser extent, you may be overlooking flaws, or simply disregarding telltale signs of AWALT simply because you have created a mindset that she is “unique” and is therefore above our wisdom. Don’t be a victim, and fall prey to the mindset of blindly and continuously believing a narrative. Assume the worst, assume the rational and probable. Be wise in all your words and actions.

The Takeaway: It is safer, wiser, and far more simple to adopt and ACT on the principle that AWALT in every single one of your relationships and encounters with women. Always come from a place of Reason and Logic, and Always improve yourself.

~Libertarian
